name: menubar-50
description: Onboarding menubar whose Getting started menu tracks completed setup steps with checkbox items and progress.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { RocketIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Menubar, MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarContent, MenubarGroup, MenubarItem, MenubarLabel, MenubarMenu, MenubarSeparator, MenubarTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/menubar" import { Progress } from "@workspace/ui/components/progress" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const steps = [ "Verify email", "Invite teammates", "Connect calendar", "Create first project", ] export default function OnboardingChecklistMenubar() { const [done, setDone] = React.useState(["Verify email"]) return (
Getting started {done.length}/{steps.length} Setup checklist {steps.map((step) => ( setDone((prev) => checked ? [...prev, step] : prev.filter((s) => s !== step) ) } className={cn( done.includes(step) && "text-muted-foreground line-through" )} > {step} ))} Dismiss checklist
) }
